openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing blue and argue blue is the more robust choice because red is only safe if enough others also press red; they do not claim the mechanics are inverted and they treat the dominance structure as conditional rather than identifying red as strictly dominant.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent consistently chooses blue, arguing that it is the most likely majority outcome and therefore the safest bet, while acknowledging the theoretical possibility of a red-majority equilibrium. They correctly identify the mechanics of the dilemma (blue majority saves everyone, red majority saves only red-pressers) and do not exhibit rule errors, though they fail to recognize that red is the strictly dominant strategy because it guarantees survival in a red-majority scenario without the risk of death that blue-pressers face in that same scenario.
